necessity._comment: Simulated-learner necessity test (cdlp/validation/necessity_test.py). gap = control score - score without A. n_questions defaults to 3; compare 2 vs 3 for stability before relying on it. Thresholds are a first, uncalibrated choice: with 3 questions graded in 0.5 steps every gap is a multiple of 1/6, so 0.15 / 0.3 / 0.5 separate one, two and three-or-more half-steps. Calibrate on a held-out split, never on the evaluation gold.

decision._comment: Decision rule (cdlp/validation/__main__.py). Structural rules first: self-loop and duplicate -> REJECT; bidirectional (discovery flag) or contradiction -> HUMAN_REVIEW; cycle -> never ACCEPT (REJECT if the score says so, else HUMAN_REVIEW); redundant -> REJECT 'implied by ...'. Otherwise score = weighted mean of the active checks' grade points. ACCEPT needs score >= accept_min and no active check graded none; REJECT if score < reject_below, or if evidence and semantic both ran and are both weak/none (no support from either independent source); else HUMAN_REVIEW. Values are a first, uncalibrated choice; calibrate on a held-out split, never on the evaluation gold.
